Subject: SVCBridge x Redwood - LangChain/LlamaIndex runtime integration request

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for taking this meeting last week — following up with the initial ask from our engineering and product teams. SVCBridge is building an ISV feature that lets our customers plugin third-party runtimes for prompt orchestration; we want Redwood to be a first-class runtime provider (LangChain & LlamaIndex connectors + tracing hooks).

High-level asks:
- Support LangChain & LlamaIndex invocation patterns (LLM chain calls, document indexes)
- Out-of-band tracing/telemetry hooks (trace id propagation + per-token metadata)
- Sandbox credentials and a short-run SLA for POC (throughput 50 req/s, p50 < 120ms for small models)

I've attached a short system diagram and our integration requirements spreadsheet. Can we set a technical deep-dive next week?

Attaching: svcbridge-architecture.pdf, svcbridge-integration-requirements.xlsx

Best,

Subject: Re: SVCBridge x Redwood - LangChain/LlamaIndex runtime integration request

Vanessa / Dana —

Quick technical note ahead of the deep-dive. High-level compatibility surface and constraints from the runtime side:

- LangChain/LlamaIndex adapters: we support both adapter-style integration (SDK shim) and a runtime-agnostic HTTP gateway. For an ISV plugin, adapter + tracing is the lowest-friction path.
- Tracing hooks: we can emit trace events to your collector or push a lightweight telemetry envelope to a joint endpoint. Recommended fields: trace_id, span_id, model_name, model_variant, prompt_id, token_count, latency_ms, quality_score (optional), customer_id.
- KV / cache behavior: LlamaIndex use-cases often rely on prefix KV caching; if SVCBridge expects consistent KV across requests we'll need to agree on cache keys and TTLs.
- Auth & sandbox: we can generate scoped API keys with rate limits and route to Dedicated pool for predictable latency.

Known performance knobs for POC: quantized model variants, request-level batching, and prefix caching. For your perf targets (50 req/s, p50 < 120ms) we'll need smaller seq lengths and potentially 8-bit variants for the POC models.

I'll bring a short demo of a LangChain adapter in the session and a trace schema proposal.

— Jonas (SE, Redwood)

Thanks for scheduling. I put together a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and acceptance criteria to discuss in the deep-dive. Key items I want us to align on during the call:

I'll share the MAP doc live in the call and capture edits. Dana — please confirm your legal review timelines so we can align the pilot start.
